concept: DynamoDB Global Tables: active-active writes in multiple regions
tests: Choosing a DB for global profiles with single-digit ms reads and writes in multiple regions.
expected: DynamoDB global tables — multi-region, active-active replication, millisecond latency. Triggers: "globally distributed", "reads and writes in multiple regions", "single-digit-millisecond".
why_not: RDS Multi-AZ — single region; ElastiCache in one region — no multi-region writes; Redshift — analytics.
